description: In the heart of District 29, a wave of change is brewing, and at the forefront of this movement is Johnny Horne. With a passion for community engagement and a commitment to making a difference, Johnny is not just a name; he represents the voice of the people. His advocacy for District 29 changes is driven by a desire to improve the quality of life for all residents. This blog post will explore Johnny's journey, the issues he is passionate about, and the impact he hopes to make in the community.W
title: Meet Johnny Horne: Advocating for District 29 Changes
